title: Installer and runtime pick the right GPU build automatically
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. A CPU build on an NVIDIA host warns and runs 17x slower; installs choose the matching asset/feature from detected hardware and a running binary that lacks the backend for its GPU says so and points to the exact fix. Tests zc_gpu_asset_*.
